target_statement: On each compact support slab, the combined completed-zeta residual obeys the harmonic Ward inequality |R(u,w)|^2 <= C_R Q_L(u,u) ||w||_2^2 for old-supported u and reference-harmonic collar w.
trust_model: This pass is a cutoff-free high-precision finite Galerkin diagnostic in ordinary mpmath, not interval arithmetic and not a continuum theorem.
first_unproved_edge: A floor-independent square-root-range/Bessel bound for the combined pole, archimedean residual, and actual prime-power translations.
mask_or_node_class: All actual zeta prime powers active immediately above L5=2 log 5, with the pole and complete archimedean residual retained.
source_data_retained: Individual prime-power locations log(n), von Mangoldt weights, underlying-prime labels, pole rank two, strict support threshold, and the digamma-minus-log-Bessel remainder.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: All real parity-complete trial functions; source signs are those of the completed zeta explicit formula.
normalization: Project support L=4a; seed L5=2 log 5; reference multiplier (1/2) log(1+4t^2); literal collars have physical width delta/4 per side.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: Not a height-window statement. The finite old Weil matrix is positive but its smallest Ritz value is allowed to become microscopic.
quantifier_order: First fix a compact support slab, then seek one C_R uniform in the old support, collar width, and all admissible functions; finite dimensions are only falsifiers for this continuum claim.
resolution_required: Old and collar meshes must be refined together with their ratio controlled; fixed-old-degree collar shrinkage is unlicensed.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.support_modulus: HRW itself is width-free relative to J*GJ; NR_log separately supplies 1/log(e/delta).

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: The prior matched finite probes gave Ward ratios 1.038--1.147 while the old Ritz floor fell substantially.
downstream_socket: HRW plus NR_log and the residual diagonal bound imply a positive adjacent-support Schur step; compact-uniform steps feed the formal cofinal propagation theorem.
parallel_open_siblings: NR_log quantitative norm-resolvent convergence for the killed log-Bessel operator
why_not_target_renamed: This audit tests the exact arithmetic factor in the established Schur reduction and keeps the independent reference localization problem separate.
abstract_convex_falsifier: Compare each source B_s, their signed sum, and source-consistent removals/sign flips in the same low-Q modes; generic positive block algebra does not force cancellation.
fejer_falsifier: Not directly applicable to this explicit-form operator claim.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Replace the newly activated n=5 contact atom by a coefficient-preserving outward smear, which leaves the old-old p5 block zero, and compare the Ward ratio.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: Extract the maximizing harmonic collar vector, decompose its response by source and old generalized eigenmode, resolve even/odd parity, and rerun matched (M,q,delta) cases.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Any favorable bound must be checked for cancellation among the completed sources before componentwise absolute values are used.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Reduces arithmetic propagation to proving the observed completed-source low-mode cancellation uniformly in the continuum.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Retires HRW as the floor-free arithmetic factor and forces a different lift/reference form or a direct full-Schur argument.
stop_rule: Stop or reframe if the combined Ward ratio diverges under licensed refinement, if boundedness comes only from an underresolved collar, or if a proposed proof silently assumes positivity after the support extension.
